title: 3 SPEED AUTO TRANS-MODULATOR PIPE
summary: Vacuum modulator line for the Turbo Hydra-Matic 3-speed automatic (RPO M40): a fitting threaded into the intake manifold (carburetor base area) feeds a steel modulator pipe that runs down the right side of the engine to the transmission vacuum modulator, with short rubber hoses joining the pipe to the fitting and to the modulator. The pipe is clipped under a transmission attaching bolt. Different fitting and pipe part numbers for LS5 and LS7 454 engines.

fastening.note: Fitting [1] threads into the manifold at the rear of the carburetor and is turned to point the hose outlet at the angle shown from the vehicle centerline (60° / 54°); torque 100-125 lb-in plus whatever is needed to align it.

Hoses [2] slip over the pipe ends: one joins the pipe to the fitting [1], the other to the modulator assembly nipple. View A: hose bottomed against the connector extension, pipe shoulder bottomed against the extension; no clamp shown.
Pipe [3] has a clip that goes under a transmission attaching bolt (production part, no callout).
